name: core-engine-nextjs-app
description: Core TypeScript engine with Next.js 14+ app

scripts.dev:always: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web-app" "nodemon --watch ./apps/web-app/src --ignore ./apps/web-app/.next --exec 'echo Restarting dev server...'" --on-change-only
scripts.dev:phone:always: concurrently "npm run dev:phone" "nodemon --watch ./apps/web-app/src --ignore ./apps/web-app/.next --exec 'echo Restarting dev server...'" --on-change-only
